entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • VS 2026 Insiders not processing .editorconfig rules properly #81260
  • Not used Namespaces are not grayed out #81259
  • Intentation in c# set to tabs and doing spaces instead #81258

Closed

  • Use expression-body code fix does not result in correct formatting #50180
    Backlog
  • Name completion help for Func<..., T> #42721
    Backlog
  • Use a canonical project for file-based apps which lack `#:` directives #81099
    18.3
  • "error CS8978: 'T' cannot be made nullable" when return type is T? #81253
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11215.03 #81262
  • IDE0051 (Remove unused private member) gets reported, when said member is used in ccode generated by an `IIncrementalGenerator` #78934
    Backlog
  • IDE0052 not displaying when collection expression is used in class #78893
    Backlog
  • IDE0052: 'Remove unread private members' should not be reported for private record fields #77907
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Extensions: rewrite extension references in EE #81263
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • For julien #81257
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use ArrayExpansion for `[InlineArray]` structs #81254
    Area-Interactive, Community

Merged

  • Improve multi-line indentation in 'use expression body' #81261
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add name completion for Func<..., T> with Factory and Selector suffixes #81244
    VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81255
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • [release/dev18.0] Fix build task integration tests #81245
  • Add colorization for array, pointer, and function pointer type aliases #81243
    VSCode
  • Update Azure pipeline queue names from vs2022 to vs2026 #80782
  • Add 'add extension completion' support for modern extensions. #81239
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Fix "Invert if" losing indentation on multi-line conditions #81249
    VSCode
  • Improve error recovery for incomplete attribute in a type-parameter. #81231
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix parenthesis brace completion for nested invocations in control flow statements and other parenthesized contexts #81242
    VSCode
  • Move IDE code over to C# 14. #79835
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use work done progress to handle restore server side #81233
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Add initial support for Union matching #81188
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: require unsafe for some pointer operations #81240
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
